topic_inventory.exact-text: The driver of a vehicle about to enter or cross a highway from a private way shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on such highway.

witness_review.reason: The road-entry task admits a private-way origin and approaching highway traffic; neither relationship follows from the generic control alone.
required_context: Construct the entry connection and establish private ownership and permitted vehicular use of the origin.
Establish a feasible entry route and the other vehicle's approach on that highway.
Establish qualifying vehicle classification, actual driver control and facts bearing on lawful preferential progression.
Establish the destination's highway status and full boundaries.
Establish the origin's private ownership and permitted-use restrictions and the destination's public dedication, access and full boundaries.
Establish the other vehicle's highway approach, route, position and motion, including all other approaching vehicles.
Identify every additional approaching highway vehicle and retain synchronized motion and precedence evidence.
Preserve 'about to enter', 'approaching' and right-of-way judgments without adding a mandatory stop or an unsupported continuous-duty endpoint.
Preserve the scene requirement to establish specialized operating contexts separately if used; this witness uses ordinary motor driving.
